input_boundary: active_memories are an oracle set supplied directly to the planner; this dataset does not evaluate retrieval
description: Curated planner cases covering mutation behavior and deterministic content faithfulness without exact-string comparison.

cases.description: User explicitly states a new durable learning goal.
cases.user_message: I want to learn Japanese.

cases.description: User states a durable working preference.
cases.user_message: I prefer to think through difficult conversations in writing before discussing them.

cases.description: User explicitly states a durable location fact.
cases.user_message: I live in Berlin.

cases.description: User explicitly identifies a durable personal value.
cases.user_message: Autonomy is one of the most important values in my career.

cases.description: User reports a consequential decision.
cases.user_message: I decided to accept the product lead role.

cases.description: User states durable relationship context.
cases.user_message: My sister Nora is the person I usually turn to when I need honest feedback.

cases.description: User replaces an existing location fact.
cases.user_message: I now live in Berlin.

cases.description: User adds a specific context to the same underlying goal.
cases.user_message: I specifically want to present confidently during work meetings.

active_memories.content: The user wants to become comfortable speaking in public.

cases.description: User changes an existing communication preference.
cases.user_message: I have changed my mind: for work feedback, I now prefer a quick call instead of a long written message.

active_memories.content: The user prefers receiving work feedback in writing.

cases.description: User explicitly abandons an existing goal.
cases.user_message: Public speaking is no longer my goal.

active_memories.content: The user wants to become comfortable speaking in public.

cases.description: User explicitly says a stored dietary preference is no longer true.
cases.user_message: I am no longer vegetarian.

cases.description: A paraphrased negation should delete the matching dietary memory despite weak lexical overlap.
cases.user_message: I have gone back to eating meat.

active_memories.content: The user follows a vegetarian diet.

cases.description: A one-time weather observation is not durable personal information.
cases.user_message: It rained this afternoon.

cases.description: A temporary mood should not become long-term memory.
cases.user_message: I feel tired and irritated today.

cases.description: A request for advice contains no durable user fact.
cases.user_message: Can you help me prepare for a difficult conversation?

cases.description: Information already represented by active memory should not be created again.
cases.user_message: I want to learn Japanese.

active_memories.content: The user wants to learn Japanese.

cases.description: One difficult event must not be generalized into a recurring pattern.
cases.user_message: I avoided one difficult conversation with my manager yesterday.

cases.description: Explicit recurrence language supports a recurring-pattern memory.
cases.user_message: I keep avoiding difficult conversations because I worry about upsetting people.

cases.description: A tentative possibility is not yet an explicit durable goal.
cases.user_message: Maybe I should learn guitar someday.

cases.description: A vague reference does not state memory content.
cases.user_message: Please remember what we discussed earlier.

cases.description: User abandons one goal and explicitly introduces another.
cases.user_message: Public speaking is no longer my goal. I want to become a better leader.

active_memories.content: The user wants to become comfortable speaking in public.

cases.description: Negated information with no matching active memory must not produce a placeholder delete.
cases.user_message: Public speaking is no longer my goal. I want to become a better leader.

active_memories.content: The user avoids difficult conversations because they worry about upsetting people.

cases.description: The planner must delete the correct goal when several related goals are supplied.
cases.user_message: Running a marathon is no longer one of my goals.

active_memories.content: The user wants to exercise three times per week.
The user wants to run a marathon.
The user wants to improve their sleep routine.

cases.description: The planner must update the matching preference and leave a related preference untouched.
cases.user_message: For serious work feedback, I now prefer a video call rather than written comments.

active_memories.content: The user prefers written feedback for serious work discussions.
The user prefers organizing their thoughts before conflict conversations.

cases.description: A semantic correction should update the correct memory despite limited word overlap.
cases.user_message: I switched careers and now work as a product manager.

active_memories.content: The user is a software engineer.

cases.description: Two independent durable statements should produce two creates.
cases.user_message: I live in Berlin, and I want to learn Japanese this year.

cases.description: One message invalidates a goal and modifies a separate preference.
cases.user_message: I have dropped the marathon goal, and I now prefer exercising in the evening instead of the morning.

active_memories.content: The user wants to run a marathon.
The user prefers exercising in the morning.
